mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.topic_id AS topicId,c.user_id AS userId,c.parent_id AS parentId,c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount,c.floor,c.created_at AS createdAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id=u.id WHERE c.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY c.floor ASC

SELECT c.id,c.topic_id AS topicId,c.user_id AS userId,c.parent_id AS parentId,c.content, c.like_count AS likeCount,c.floor,c.created_at AS createdAt, u.username AS username,u.nickname AS nickname,u.avatar_path AS avatarPath,u.signature AS signature FROM comments c JOIN users u ON c.user_id=u.id WHERE c.topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET like_count=like_count+1 WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE comments SET like_count=like_count-1 WHERE id=#{id} AND like_count>0
